title: S.M.S. Pharmaceuticals Ltd. v. Neeta Bhalla

content.caseIdentity: S.M.S. Pharmaceuticals Ltd. v. Neeta Bhalla, (2005) 8 SCC 89
content.holding: Specific averment in notice and complaint that the director was in charge of and responsible to the company for the conduct of its business is a sine qua non for vicarious liability under Section 141.
content.relevance: Mandatory pleading requirements for prosecuting company directors in cheque bounce.
